description:
Build schema file paths through one validated `VirtualPath` constructor.

## Background

Schema paths under `.jit/schemas` are spelled at `crates/jit/src/repository_state/initialize.rs:341,392,597`, `repository_state/mod.rs:1126`, `repository_state/profile_apply.rs:1881` and `repository_state/materialize.rs:290,538,592,639`. Rule serialization embeds a schema path in reference text (`repository_state/rule_serialize.rs:261`), and rule loading checks references with `starts_with("schemas/")` (`declarations/rules.rs:1525`). `VirtualPath::SCHEMAS` names the directory (`repository_state/path.rs`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `VirtualPath::schema(name)` validates a single file-name component and is the only builder of a schema file path.
- [hard] REQ-02: No production `format!` or string concatenation spells a `schemas/` path, and the rule-loading check uses the constructor.
title: Schema paths come from a VirtualPath constructor
